details: Bitcoin has experienced a slight pullback, dropping over 2% in the past 24 hours and retreating from the $84,000 level. This pause follows the Federal Reserve's recent rate hike to 4% and comes as investors anticipate a series of key U.S. economic data releases this week. These include jobless claims, housing prices, GDP, the core Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) price index, ISM Manufacturing PMI, and the highly anticipated nonfarm payrolls report. The data will offer clues on future monetary policy and its impact on risk assets like cryptocurrencies.
title: Bitcoin Dips as Investors Await Key US Economic Data

details: Bitcoin "whale" wallets, holding between 100-1,000 BTC, have collectively added 113,950 Bitcoins since early July, pushing their total holdings to 5.24 million BTC. This accumulation coincides with significant inflows into spot Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs), which attracted $1.7 billion in just the last 48 hours. This indicates growing institutional and large-investor demand for Bitcoin, suggesting potential for further price increases despite recent market pullbacks.
title: Bitcoin Whales Accumulate, Spot ETF Inflows Signal Bullish Demand
